header: Step 6: Choose an algorithm and build the model
content:
Note
You must perform this step outside of OpenSearch Service.
With the training dataset in place, the next step is to use XGBoost or Ranklib libraries to build a
model. XGBoost and Ranklib libraries let you build popular models such as LambdaMART, Random
Forests, and so on.
For steps to use XGBoost and Ranklib to build the model, see the XGBoost and RankLib
documentation, respectively. To use Amazon SageMaker to build the XGBoost model, see XGBoost
Algorithm.
